name: NGC 1129, SN 2007ke field (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1129, an early-type galaxy with a double core, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2007ke-hubble
story: SN 2007ke, a calcium-rich supernova, went off in the faint halo light far from the center of NGC 1129. Hubble resolved that galaxy's heart into two cores, the mark of an ongoing merger.

claims.text: NGC 1129 is the adopted host of SN 2007ke
NGC 1129 is an early-type galaxy with a double core
Calcium-rich transients are a peculiar class of explosion in which up to half the ejecta is calcium
SN 2007ke lies far from its host's center, in the halo light of nearby galaxies
Hubble resolved NGC 1129's center into a double core, an ongoing merger
